inv.desc_en:
Commercial premises. - Parque Alcosa area of 50 m2 built ACCORDING TO CADASTRAL RECORDS

Layout: it has two rooms, a small space used as a storage room, and a restroom.
5 linear meters of frontage.

Utilities not included.

Metal shutter.

Currently rented, approx. 4.5% profitability.

Terrazzo floors.

LOCATION. - Near commercial areas, next to a school, shops, bars, public park, public swimming pool. Bus stop just a few meters away.

CONTACT-
Contact us if you are interested in this property, or if you would like us to provide you with any other information.
INVERSIONES REINA Real Estate Agency 954 22 52 02
We look forward to hearing from you! We would be delighted to assist you.
Taxes according to Law, and expenses generated by the transfer (SALE / RENT), NOT included in the price. Decree of the Regional Government of Andalusia 218/2005.
